[EN] Raven Altar. That's not a very fuzzy sounding place.

They probably don't hold a lot of feasts at Raven Altar.

Well, maybe sacrificial feasts...
[ES] Raven Altar. Ese no suena como un lugar muy acogedor.

Probablemente no celebren muchos banquetes en Raven Altar.

Bueno, tal vez banquetes de sacrificios...
